# Retired regression fixtures

The owner retired Slicks tracks from the game on 2026-09-17. These 194 immutable native-grid fixtures and their original provenance manifest are retained only for historical collision, bridge, handling and replay regression checks. They are not registered in BuiltinTracks or available as creator base tracks. Android exports exclude `tests/*`, including this directory. Do not restore these files to `resources/tracks` or the playable catalog. Raw source archives and offline import documentation remain historical material outside the export root.

Every native file SHA-256 was checked against catalog.json after the move: 194 matches, zero mismatches. No player files are stored here. See docs/AUTOMATIC_WAYPOINTS.md at the repository root for the active product change.
